title: Not every substrate can implement the relevant computations

statements.text: Computational functionalism does not entail that any substrate can be used to build a conscious system: as Michel and Lau put it, Swiss cheese cannot implement the relevant computations. The report tentatively assumes, without claiming certainty, that computers as known today can in principle implement algorithms sufficient for consciousness.

sources.quote: Swiss cheese cannot implement the relevant computations
We tentatively assume that computers as we know them are in principle capable of implementing algorithms sufficient for consciousness
